comment: installed_bytes is the size target for the featured export on disk. Every game's player carries glcore, slang and their compilers, so a game can bundle slang shaders, and the Windows launcher carries SDL2 to rumble DualSense and Xbox pads in a sandboxed game.
comment-intel-macs: A game that also runs on Intel Macs carries Apple silicon's and Intel's player and core, so it has a ceiling of its own. Each processor's player also carries SDL2 for its controllers.
